The exact planetary-scale mechanisms that maintain ocean pH and carbonate chemistry under massive anthropogenic CO₂ and other inputs.

AER-04.reason: No reviewed source specifies a full-scale transition-control mechanism for maintaining laminar flow. Generic flow-separation control does not establish this distinct requirement.

AER-09.reason: No qualified inertial or quantum sensing, calibration and drift-correction architecture is specified by another original milestone.

ROC-01.reason: This orbital vehicle ambition overlaps AER-03 nearly verbatim. Retain both as overlapping goals rather than invent a vehicle-to-vehicle prerequisite.

ROC-06.reason: No reviewed source supplies a suitably lightweight multi-megawatt power, conversion and heat-rejection design; nuclear-power ambitions do not automatically meet in-space mass and thrust needs.

ROC-07.reason: No specified shielding/refrigeration architecture supplies the multi-year propellant heat balance. A cryogenic computing package is not a storage solution.

MNE-05.reason: Fiber transmission and terrestrial terahertz communication do not solve repeater-free underwater wireless propagation. No qualified underwater link mechanism was identified.

MNE-08.reason: No reviewed hull/restoring-force and sea-state mechanism establishes the stated stability. A vibration isolator would not automatically stabilize the entire vessel.

PET-03.reason: No reviewed source specifies an injectable reservoir-qualified catalyst for the required heavy-hydrocarbon cracking; methane oxidation is a different reaction goal.

PET-06.reason: Net-zero operation needs an explicit energy/emissions system boundary and balance. Water reuse or gas conversion alone does not establish a net-zero platform.

PET-10.reason: No listed material or system is qualified for the simultaneous stated pressure, temperature, chemistry and production lifetime; a generic hot alloy is not enough.

GEO-01.reason: A historical impact reconstruction does not specify a direct capability or required input among the other original targets.

GEO-05.reason: No reviewed measurement or inversion model identifies core light elements; mantle and surface dynamics do not uniquely supply that composition.

GEO-07.reason: The missing-record explanation lacks a specified measurement or process pathway connecting it causally to another listed target.

GEO-09.reason: No particular emplacement mechanism is supplied, so no granite-to-geothermal or construction capability is inferred.

GEO-10.reason: The source leaves the polar-motion mechanism unspecified; related deep-Earth questions do not establish a directional dependency.

OCE-02.reason: No regional transfer model connects the proposed ENSO forecast to a specific agricultural or coastal-control capability. Generic weather-benefit arrows were rejected.

OCE-03.reason: The carbon-pump ambition has no reviewed quantitative coupling to another original target’s complete chemical or ecological endpoint.

OCE-06.reason: The bacterial glow mechanism is unspecified; a marine coordination observation is not assumed to provide a usable engineered microbial control system.

OCE-08.reason: The metabolic pathway is the discovery goal itself. No energy-harvesting or synthetic-metabolism implementation follows without identifying it.

rejectedCandidates.reason: Guided fiber transmission is not repeater-free underwater wireless communication.
Internal-wave cascades and open-ocean surface rogue waves are not interchangeable mechanisms.
A gigawatt-hour lifetime energy target does not specify multi-megawatt instantaneous power or flight mass.
Methane oxidation does not supply an injectable heavy-oil cracking catalyst.
